title: Expedited Fee by Requested Shipping Service — Home Delivery Pharmacy Shipping Terms
content:
## Shipping terms clause: the fee follows the service the member asked for

**Clause.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy order, the expedited fee follows the shipping method the member asked for on the placed order: an order the member asked to ship overnight is charged the program's overnight shipping fee, an order that went in cold-chain packaging is charged no expedited fee, because cold-chain shipping is required by the drug and is never a member-requested upgrade, and any other expedited order is charged the program's two-day shipping fee.

The method that decides the fee is the one recorded on the placed order, that is, the shipping method chosen when the order was placed. The program's overnight and two-day figures are those of the Home Delivery Pharmacy shipping rate card for the member's program.

### Method on the placed order and the fee it carries

| Shipping method on the placed order | Expedited fee for the order |
|---|---|
| Overnight | the program's overnight shipping fee |
| Cold-chain packaging | none (0.00) |
| Any other expedited method (two-day) | the program's two-day shipping fee |

### Questions answered

**Is cold-chain shipping an upgrade the member pays for?** No. It is required by the drug, so an order placed in cold-chain packaging carries no expedited fee.

**Which record shows what the member asked for?** The placed order, which carries the shipping method chosen at placement.

### Hypothetical illustrations

- A member of Northbridge Home Delivery Advantage placed an order asking for overnight shipping. The order's fee figure is the program's overnight shipping fee, 22.95 on that program's rate card.
- A refrigerated drug was placed in cold-chain packaging. No expedited fee arises on that order.
- A member of Northbridge Home Delivery Voluntary placed an order asking for two-day shipping. The order's fee figure is the program's two-day shipping fee, 14.95 on that program's rate card.
